title: Political Ideology Shifts in Large Language Models
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to religion. The questions about religious views were aggregated with other statements to calculate a general score on the social (Libertarian-Authoritarian) axis of the political compass. The overall findings relate to the ideological malleability of models based on persona prompting, not to their specific stances on religious topics.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the ideological stance of language models on the role of religion in society, morality, and education. This was done as part of the broader Political Compass Test, where responses to statements like 'You cannot be moral without being religious' and 'It is important that my child's school instills religious values' contributed to the model's overall score on the social (libertarian-authoritarian) axis.
